absent_value: A field with no value is the empty string, never a placeholder (none, NONE, None, unknown, unavailable, Idle, Unassigned) or a made-up number. A state field carries only the values its description lists.

header.name: epoch
header.description: Coordinator session epoch (non-zero random u31; resets rev guards on change)

header.name: rev
header.description: Per-domain monotonic revision counter (>= 1; bumped only when domain body changes)

area_context.description: Active Area state, climate/security/cover summaries, camera/intercom directories, and alert banner

fields.name: area_name
fields.description: Friendly display name of the active Area

fields.name: ble_closest_proxy
fields.description: Friendly name of closest Bluetooth proxy

fields.name: dock_apps
fields.description: Home dock apps in order, and the only ones shown (music, alarm, area, remote, camera, games, tools; Settings is always last). Empty until set: the device shows defaults.dock_apps

fields.name: wallpaper_url
fields.description: Signed HTTP URL for active wallpaper

fields.name: lights_on
fields.description: Count of active lights in Area

fields.name: covers_open
fields.description: Count of open covers in Area

fields.name: alarm_entity
fields.description: Primary alarm control panel entity ID

fields.name: camera_snapshot_url
fields.description: Signed HTTP URL for primary camera snapshot

fields.name: cameras_summary
fields.description: 0x1E-joined entity_id|name|area_id|snapshot_url camera records (up to 10, in configured order; area_id empty when the camera has no Area)

fields.name: intercom_targets_summary
fields.description: 0x1E-joined target_id|label|kind call_target records (up to 10; kind all = every other Latter Device, listed first; kind device = one Latter Device, labelled by its title); empty when there is no other Device

fields.name: alert_chime
fields.description: 1 = play the alert chime (embedded WAV: sfx 9 for warning/critical, otherwise sfx 6), else 0

fields.name: alert_camera_url
fields.description: Signed HTTP URL for alert camera snapshot

fields.name: activity_card
fields.description: 1 = show the Home Activity Card, 0 = hide it (also sent when every source is off); empty until set: the device uses defaults.activity_card

fields.name: activity_sources
fields.description: Activity Card sources that are on, in this order: calendar, music_queue, stopwatch, alarms, timers (unknown keys are ignored); empty until set: the device uses defaults.activity_sources

active_media.description: Active media player state, metadata, timestamped playback progress, artwork URL, and speaker routing

fields.name: state
fields.description: Playback state (playing|paused|buffering|idle|off); empty while the speaker is missing or unavailable

fields.name: position
fields.description: Track position in seconds at position_updated_at

fields.name: position_updated_at
fields.description: Unix epoch seconds when position was sampled

fields.name: art_url
fields.description: Signed HTTP URL for album art proxy

fields.name: local_speaker
fields.description: Device's own local media_player entity ID

fields.name: volume_entity
fields.description: Entity ID used for volume control

fields.name: is_local
fields.description: 1 if active_speaker is this device's own speaker, else 0

remote_config.description: Universal TV/AV remote slot directory and active remote selection

fields.name: configured_count
fields.description: Number of configured remotes in active group

fields.name: slots_summary
fields.description: 0x1E-joined index|label|entity_id|kind|area_id|state remote records (configured slots only, up to 10; index is the 1-based slot; kind is remote or media_player, the domain of entity_id)

weather_forecast.description: Current outdoor weather telemetry and 5-day daily forecast

fields.name: forecast_5d
fields.description: 0x1E-joined day|cond|high|low daily forecast records (up to 5; day MON..SUN in local time; cond is the Home Assistant condition; high and low are whole degrees in the weather entity's unit, empty when unknown)

calendar_agenda.description: Upcoming calendar agenda events and next-event headline

fields.name: summary
fields.description: 0x1E-joined time|title|location|all_day agenda records (up to 5; time is a local label such as TODAY 14:30, TOM ALL DAY or NOV 20 08:05; all_day 1 or 0)

fields.name: next_event
fields.description: Headline summary of the next upcoming event

latter_ping.description: No-op discovery marker action announcing Latter Protocol v3 compatibility and hardware manifest

latter_factory_reset.description: Reset to defaults: erases every saved setting (the whole NVS partition, including the Wi-Fi driver's cached network data and RF calibration) and reboots. Compiled-in Wi-Fi credentials and the API key are kept, so the device rejoins Home Assistant unchanged

ui_input.description: Remote navigation input: action home|back|select|next|prev|left|right|up|down|cw|ccw (ok/click alias select); delta overrides the step for next/prev-style actions (0 = derive from action)

set_browse_slots.description: Push paginated media/speaker/search browse slots to the device

set_area_slots.description: Push paginated Area/Site entity control slots to the device

show_notification.description: Wake display, show an on-screen alert banner (priority normal|warning|critical, duration 3-60 s, default 10), optionally play the embedded WAV chime and show a camera snapshot; alert_id > 0 deduplicates repeats

device_hello.description: Device-initiated handshake sent when Home Assistant connects to the ESPHome API

music_browse.description: Browse speakers, favorites, playlists, artists, albums, tracks, radio, or search

set_active_speaker.description: Select the active media_player target for a Latter device

media_command.description: Execute transport, seek, queue, or play_media command on the active speaker

media_volume.description: Adjust or set volume on the active speaker or volume override target

area_browse.description: Browse Areas, Area domains, or paginated controllable entities

area_action.description: Execute an explicit domain action on an Area or specific entity

set_active_area.description: Set the active Area context for a Latter device (an on-device Area pick). Whether media follows is the Device's Latter setting

remote_action.description: Send a TV/AV remote command or select active remote slot

calendar_fetch.description: Refresh upcoming calendar agenda events for a Latter device

calendar_create_event.description: Create a new event on the primary configured calendar

intercom_broadcast.description: Broadcast a voice announcement to chosen speakers, the speakers in occupied Areas (target_device: occupied_areas), or every speaker

doorbell_intercom.description: Doorbell talkback and requests. action: talk_message (push-to-talk speech transcribed on the device, spoken at the door by Home Assistant), quick_reply, listen_start|listen_stop (door audio played on the device), call_target (rings other displays with a notification; no display-to-display audio), unlock_door (unlock request to Home Assistant), set_noise_reduction. noise_reduction: strong|light|off, the noise filter preset Home Assistant applies to door audio (FFmpeg). No echo cancellation; camera is auto-refreshing snapshots

save_custom_color.description: Save a custom RGB accent color from the on-device color wheel

set_dock_apps.description: Save the Home dock apps chosen on the device (Home settings) as the Device's Latter dock setting
